relationships.evidence_quote: lesions to the spinal nerve result in the rapid activation of JAK/STAT3 in the dorsal spinal cord microglia together with increased levels of spinal IL6

relationships.subject: JAK/STAT pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: nerve injury-induced astrocyte proliferation requires activation of the JAK/STAT3 signaling pathway

relationships.subject: tofacitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: tofacitinib preferentially inhibits both JAK1 and JAK3 and partially inhibits JAK2

relationships.subject: JAK inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: results from phase 3 RCTs demonstrate that JAK inhibitors such as tofacitinib and upadacitinib can improve disease severity in axSpA patients
